verdict.rationale: vLLM is an LLM inference and serving engine. User-defined event-triggered automation rules are a workflow-automation capability outside its product category, and nothing in the evidence shows vLLM ships such a feature. Tool calling (vllm-docs-19) is the model choosing functions within a chat completion request. It is not a rule engine that fires actions on events, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
